experimental.align: Automatic lyrics sync with the audio
experimental.alignNote: Aligns lyrics with the audio (word, syllable and approximate vowel) and lets you review them before exporting a NEW TTML: your original file is never modified. It uses the GPU and, when installed, downloads several GB. It shows up as “Sync with audio” in the Editor menu.
experimental.wordfxNote: Individual words in the lyrics react to their meaning and emotion (time, loss, love…), only within the word. You see it in the preview and in the export. The category library is editable: docs/wordfx.md.
experimental.loopNote: Adds a seamless loop switch to the Editor for exports of selected verses.

keys.note: Keys are stored in the Windows Credential Manager (encrypted for your user), never in the app folder. Spicy Lyrics: client key (sl_pk_…) from developers.spicylyrics.org with “Allow requests with no Origin header” turned on; it provides syllable-level lyrics from Apple Music and the community. LRCLIB needs no key. Tidal isn't available: it has no official account access.
